chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Whoever goes out on a journey and does not wrap the turban under his chin, then an ailment for which there is no remedy afflicts him, let him blame none but himself.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about traveling without wrapping the turban under the chin?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an instruction concerning travel etiquette connected to wearing the turban properly. It warns that neglecting this practice may lead to harm, placing responsibility upon the person himself.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.818 - Ammar al-Sabati narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"Whoever goes out on a journey without wrapping the turban under his chin and suffers from an ailment for which there is no remedy, let him blame none but himself”.
